candidates.name: Hierarchical Data Format Version 5 (HDF5)
verified_facts: HDF5 is a data model, programming interface and storage model for large and complex data, including multidimensional numeric arrays.
The OGC HDF5 core standard describes a self-describing encoding suitable for scientific and engineering geospatial applications.
semantic_limits: A self-describing multidimensional storage format does not prove LiDAR classification, survey date, vertical datum, source accuracy or parcel-specific sampling correctness.

candidates.name: Zarr Storage Specification
verified_facts: Zarr defines storage for N-dimensional arrays and associated metadata using chunked array data and JSON metadata.
The specification supports key-value stores including file systems and cloud object storage.
semantic_limits: Chunking, compression, cloud storage and metadata layout do not establish terrain semantics, vertical error, observation quality or parcel-level provenance.
